requirement_summary: SMB ecommerce: chat-first workload for order support. Traffic: bursty, low concurrency, target latency <300ms for interactive flows. Cost-sensitive; wants hosted API. Critical: per-session opt-out, configurable log TTL (24h-90d), export/delete for GDPR requests, confirmation that prompts are not used for training unless explicitly opted-in.
security_questions_log_retention: Customer asked: 1) default log retention for hosted API? 2) can retention be shortened per-account/route? 3) how to opt individual conversations out of retention? 4) are prompts/contexts stored separately from telemetry?
proposed_answers_summary: We can offer hosted API with configurable retention TTLs on logs (default 30d for SMB tier) and per-account routes; support a request header (x-redwood-no-store) to mark calls as transient — flagged requests are not written to persistent prompt logs and excluded from training data. EU traffic can be routed to eu-west-1 and log residency ensured. Data purge API exists (/v1/admin/purge) for enterprise; for SMB propose a managed purge workflow via support ticket if no self-serve API is enabled. Need to confirm SLA for purge timing.
